scope: Read-only audit of actual entry, two dialogs, daily and weekly analyses. No prompt/runtime changes or paid replay.

quality.verdict: Useful mechanisms and practical steps retained; explicit latest correction respected in dialogs. Accuracy is improved locally but not consistently enforced.
strengths: Keeps the 10 km goal while distinguishing motivation from devaluation of an achieved result.
Does not close the 5 km milestone before next-day recovery is observed.
Daily analysis distinguishes another person's possible intention from the impact of their reply.
Weekly analysis connects work, leisure, comparison and interpersonal boundaries with concrete episodes.
Weekly walking count is supported: 30,35,30,25,30,20,80 minutes; five complete and two partial days.
issues: Entry calls a mechanism familiar but does not explicitly connect it to the highly relevant Sep19/20/24 episodes supplied in context.
Daily analysis upgrades a possible need to reduce uncertainty into an asserted cause; not sending a message is categorically interpreted as not swallowing hurt.
Weekly analysis says the previous 3 km walk ended because legs were heavy. Source says the return followed noticing pursuit of a round number; heaviness was reported the next day.
Weekly analysis calls an unlogged screen pause an unrealized idea: lack of records does not establish nonperformance, and the daily input includes two older completions.
Week combines agreeing on behalf of a partner with wanting to be heard, though these episodes do not establish the same motive.

entry.notes: Same nine sources delivered, with linked plans, planner context and briefs. Final message token count includes its wrappers.

context.overagePolicy: Whole final capsule retained as approved. No source dropped solely to fit the nominal cap.
